en.headline: 406 commits, 9 PRs and 61 issues across OpenCode skill and tooling repos
en.teaser: Thirty days of building agent skills and OpenCode tooling, with 406 own commits plus 491 automated ones, 9 pull requests and 61 issues, mostly filed upstream against OpenChamber and opencode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24 with data for every day. Totals are 406 own commits, 9 pull requests, 61 issues and 0 reviews; a further 491 automated commits were recorded separately.

### Skill and tooling repositories

Most of the authoring work went into `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the profile repository was reworked: copy switched to English, a 30-day activity card and a daily auto-update workflow were added, the daily report moved to a rolling two-hour refresh with manual date input, and CI was upgraded from the deprecated Node 20 runtime, plus fixes so statistics and breakdowns cannot disagree.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` produced four releases (v0.1.0 through v0.4.0) covering a bilingual landing page on GitHub Pages, a first-class observations evidence type with C1-C8 fixes, validation scripts and CI, and eventually a split into three cooperating skills with a thin `meld.py` CLI. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` started from scratch: an MV3 extension skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, page-state resets between runs, JSDoc checkJs type checking and DOM smoke tests.

### Inventory, model picker and skill management

`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` shipped v1.14.0 and v1.15.0, adding a one-command skills.sh install across seven READMEs and a workflow-first restructure of SKILL.md. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.3.0 and v1.4.0, adding agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, proxy-aware network helpers and preserved snapshot preferences. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` reached v0.2.0 and then v1.0.0 with the `skill_management` plugin for list, inspect, disable and enable. Smaller work included knowledge notes in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and capture samples in `sogeisetsu/myBlog`.

### Upstream reports and reviews

Outside own repositories most activity was issue reporting. `openchamber/openchamber` received reports on comment selection, context-panel percentages, 1x browser captures, unlinkable agent items, stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md, Go quota configuration and missing auto-update metadata. `anomalyco/opencode` got reports on MiMo image input being rejected, stale vision reads, subagent `model_coming_soon` failures, running the CLI on Windows and the tinyfish websearch provider. Four fixes were opened against `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` and later merged, one listing PR went to `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` for `asset-inventory`, and indexing requests were filed with `vercel-labs/skills`. Smaller reports covered OpenCode V2 compatibility in SenseNova skills and OfficeCLI, and session discovery in `oh-my-opencode-slim`. No reviews were recorded, and some earlier dates were reconstructed via GitHub Search, so star counts are unavailable and release data covers only the author's own repositories.

zh.headline: OpenCode 技能与工具仓库三十天：406 次提交、9 个 PR、61 个 issue
zh.teaser: 这三十天主要在做 Agent Skill 与 OpenCode 工具链，本人提交 406 次，另有 491 次自动提交，并提交 9 个 PR、61 个 issue，多数报给了 OpenChamber 与 opencode。
zh.overview:
窗口为 2026-09-25 至 2026-10-24，每天都有数据。总计本人提交 406 次、PR 9 个、issue 61 个、评审 0 次，另有 491 次自动提交单独统计。

### 技能与工具仓库

主要开发投入在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：个人主页仓库把文案统一改为英文，新增近 30 天活动卡片与每日自动更新 workflow，日报改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期，CI 也把 checkout/setup-node 从已弃用的 Node 20 运行时升级，并修复了统计数字与拆分会不一致的问题。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 连发四个版本（v0.1.0 到 v0.4.0），内容包括 GitHub Pages 双语落地页、一等公民的 observations 证据类型与 C1-C8 修复、校验脚本与 CI，最终拆成三个协作技能并配一个精简的 `meld.py` 命令行。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从空仓库起步，完成了 MV3 扩展骨架、带预设和术语表流水线的 provider 协议层、支持分块与熔断的整页双语渲染、翻译间状态重置、JSDoc 的 checkJs 类型检查以及 DOM 冒烟测试。

### 清单、模型选择与技能管理

`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 发布 v1.14.0 与 v1.15.0，七种语言的 README 都加上了 skills.sh 一键安装，SKILL.md 改为工作流优先结构。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 v1.0.0、v1.1.0、v1.3.0 和 v1.4.0，加入代理发现与快照摘要脚本、支持代理的网络辅助函数，并保留了刷新时的快照偏好。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 先到 v0.2.0 再到 v1.0.0，实现 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable。其余零散工作在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 记录知识笔记，在 `sogeisetsu/myBlog` 添加截图样例。

### 上游报告与评审

自有仓库之外的精力主要在上报问题。`openchamber/openchamber` 收到关于行号拖动评论不可靠、上下文面板百分比、200% 缩放下截图只有 1 倍、Agent 条目无法解绑、AGENTS.md 被静默覆盖、Go 额度显示未配置、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新元数据等报告。`anomalyco/opencode` 收到 MiMo 图片输入被拒、视觉读到旧图、子代理报 model_coming_soon、Windows 桌面无法运行 CLI、tinyfish 搜索返回 400 等报告。针对 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 提出并合并了四个修复 PR，向 `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 提交了一个收录 `asset-inventory` 的 PR，也向 `vercel-labs/skills` 提交了索引请求。另有 SenseNova 技能与 OfficeCLI 的 OpenCode V2 兼容问题，以及 `oh-my-opencode-slim` 的会话发现问题。本窗口没有评审记录；部分早期日期由 GitHub Search 回溯，星标数不可用，发布信息只覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: 本窗口连发四个版本，从 v0.1.0 到 v0.4.0，最终拆为三个协作技能并由一个 meld.py 命令行统一调用。
v1.14.0 为全部七种语言 README 加上 skills.sh 一键安装；v1.15.0 将宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先。
v1.4.0 加入共享的 JSON 与代理辅助函数，并让代理发现输出 mode、hidden 与 traits 字段。
v1.0.0 冻结 skill_management 的接口，保留 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作。
该 PR 强化解析、聚合与安装环节的评测健壮性，2026-09-28 开启，2026-10-01 关闭。
Behavior 设置页在外部修改 AGENTS.md 后保存会静默覆盖，2026-09-25 关闭。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，而 Go 端点对图片一律返回 400。
提交一个收录 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 的 PR，将其加入 awesome-agent-skills 列表。
